title: Free audio · LibriVox
blurb: Volunteers reading public-domain books aloud. The catalogue is uneven, the recordings are free, and the whole archive is downloadable.

items.d: Several complete readings of Austen's novel, from solo to dramatic.
The full whale, chapter by chapter, by more than one voice.
Doyle's first collection, read as the stories were meant to be heard.
Shelley's novel in several complete readings, solo and collaborative.
The fables that taught Europe its morals, in several translations.
Gilman's short story of a room, a marriage and a descent.
